items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dr. Carroll was one of my teachers at one time, and it must have been history, right?

ctx.x: Was Dr. Carroll your history teacher? Was he there, because I remember . . .
Dr. Carroll was one of my teachers at one time, and it must have been history, right? Because that was his bag.
One of the first people to teach black history.
